ActionDescriptions.ToGetHeartbeatStatus:
to get heartbeat status
sourceSessionKey - optional source session key filter. Use empty string for all jobs.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetHeartbeatSubscriptions:
to get heartbeat service subscriptions
Return active heartbeat jobs and heartbeat.service session-event subscriptions.
ActionDescriptions.ToStartHeartbeatSubscription:
to send heartbeat events to a session
sessionKey - subscriber session receiving heartbeat events. message - payload text included in heartbeat callback.
ActionDescriptions.ToStartHeartbeatSubscriptionWithOptions:
to configure heartbeat interval and count
sessionKey - subscriber session receiving heartbeat events. message - payload text included in heartbeat callback. intervalSeconds - seconds between ticks. maxCount - number of heartbeat ticks to send.
ActionDescriptions.ToStopHeartbeatSubscription:
to stop a heartbeat subscription
jobId - heartbeat job id returned by start/status methods.
